Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
If Reg Driscoll already has a Laptop Computer, can he equip with another
one to move it to a different minion (who doesn't have a Laptop)?

Laptop text: "The minion with this equipment gets +1 bleed. A minion may
have only 1 Laptop Computer."

Reg Driscoll text: "If Reg performs a successful equip action, you may
move the equipment to any ready minion you control."

I suspect the answer is "no, because Reg can't try to equip with a
Laptop that he can't have (since he already has one)." But if you're
only not allowed to *have* a second Laptop (and could equip with a
second one normally, which would then burn due to not being legal on the
minion), he might be able to get around it.

thanks,

Josh

Messages.Author: Timlagor
Messages.Body:
Joshua Duffin expounded:


Can "move" it to another minion. This implies that he must get it before
it goes to the other minion and therefore there would be a moment when
he had 2. Also he cannot attempt to equip something that he cannot have
so the second option wouldn't come in anyway. Sorry. He'll just have to
recruit Tasha/Simmons and not keep his first laptop.
